seoCopy: Sunset Garden features a burnt-orange base with multicolour floral and paisley-inspired motifs, gold-toned beadwork, pearl-style accents and embellished puff sleeves. The listed technique combines Aari-style floral embroidery, beadwork and pearl-style embellishment; exact materials should be confirmed for the chosen version rather than assumed from a photograph. The warm palette can work with orange, rust, gold, cream or complementary silk sarees, while a saree border that repeats one of the accent colours can help the outfit feel intentional. Compare the design with your actual saree and jewellery, especially where the blouse sleeve detail meets the border. The listed starting price is ₹8,499 for hand embroidery on a customer-supplied blouse or garment; the garment, courier and changes beyond the displayed materials are separate. No fixed crafting timeline is advertised. Share the event date, garment readiness and desired coverage in your enquiry, and Khadeeja Designs will confirm whether the requested work fits the current studio schedule before accepting the order.
